handling.classification_input: review_text only (stars, likes, version and timestamp stay metadata)
handling.duplicate_review_id: first occurrence kept; later rows reported here and excluded
handling.empty_text: quarantined with reason empty_review_text; never sent to a model
handling.exact_duplicate_text: one model result per distinct text; other rows get cache_source_id provenance
